summary: Frontend-only regression + bug-fix verification for MoldingSheet STL/STEP import. All bug-fix acceptance criteria pass: on uploading /app/test_fixtures/test_box_40x30x2p5.stl (a 40x30x2.5mm box) the ray-casting thickness estimator produces exact 2.50mm for medio/max/sezione sottile, Vol=3.00 cm³, area proiettata=12.0 cm², percorso=25.0 mm. File input accept attribute contains all 6 variants (.stl,.STL,.step,.STEP,.stp,.STP). STEP engine loads from CDN and attempts parsing (occt-import-js WASM initializes; console shows OpenCascade 'Interruption ReadFile par Exception' when handed an empty stub STEP, as expected). Non-regression on login (admin/admin123), tab navigation Stampo→Pressa→Iniezione→Chiusura→Tempi, material autopopulation (density_solid=1), and calc pipeline CM/QSCM/Qcomm all confirmed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for STL thickness reading and STEP support is fully verified. estimateThickness returns spMin/spMed/spMax = 2.5/2.5/2.5 mm on the test_box_40x30x2p5.stl fixture. Accept attribute on data-testid=stl-input is '.stl,.STL,.step,.STEP,.stp,.STP'. occt-import-js loads and initializes from CDN (verified via console logs during a stub STEP upload). Tab navigation, material select autofill, and calc chain (CM/QSCM/Qcomm on tab 3) are non-regressed. Only cosmetic hydration warning remains on the Copia-da-stampo <option>.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of previous bug: computeMeshMetrics used Math.min(bbX,bbY,bbZ) as wall thickness, which is only correct for slabs aligned to axes. Fix: added estimateThickness() that ray-casts from each triangle's centroid along the inward-facing normal (Möller–Trumbore) accelerated by a 3D-DDA voxel grid, then takes 5th/50th/95th percentiles of the hit distances. Verified on the fixture (12-triangle 40×30×2.5 box): 4 valid samples, all returning 2.5 mm, giving spMin=spMed=spMax=2.5. NOTE: on very small meshes (≤~12 triangles) the sample count is low (only 4 here) — for real production parts with thousands of triangles the percentile distribution will be more meaningful, but the algorithm is correct.
